description.en: Turn product screens into a coherent launch sequence with legible UI and spatial transitions.
description.zh: 把产品界面变成连贯的发布叙事，并保持 UI 清晰可读。

prompt: Build a polished 15-second software launch film from UI Screens 1, 2, and 3. Preserve the interface copy, icon shapes, data values, spacing, and brand colors; do not fabricate controls. Start close on the waveform in Screen 1 as the playhead moves from left to right. The waveform expands into a three-dimensional timeline, and the camera travels through it into Screen 2. At 7 seconds, one card from Screen 2 rotates forward and becomes the full layout of Screen 3. Add small cursor interactions only where an existing control is visible. Use crisp orthographic motion, restrained depth, soft studio shadows, and one yellow signal color for active states. End with all three screens arranged as a clean product system. No illegible microtext, warped panels, fake notifications, or device mockups.
